ratios.quote: The Company’s actual net leverage ratio of 3.85 as of June 30, 2026 exceeded the 3.75 maximum net leverage ratio then applicable to the quarter under the Tenth Amendment.

ratios.facility: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (Credit Facility), as amended by the Tenth Amendment
ratios.quote: Under the terms of the Tenth Amendment, the maximum permitted net leverage ratio was set at 3.75, specifically for the fiscal quarters ended March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026, before generally stepping down from 4.00 to 3.00 by the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

parsed.notes: At June 30, 2026 the actual net leverage ratio (3.85) breached the 3.75 maximum; the lenders granted a waiver on July 15, 2026. The Eleventh Amendment (Aug 7, 2026) resets future limits: max net leverage 4.25 from Sept 30, 2026, stepping down to 3.75 by June 30, 2027 (MD&A also describes up to 4.00 in fiscal 2027), and lowers the minimum interest coverage ratio to 2.00 for fiscal 2027. No actual interest coverage ratio or its prior requirement is disclosed. No March 31, 2026 actual is given.
